'''Ord Hallitron''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. An [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]], Ord Hallitron was used by the [[Pius Dea]]-controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a staging point for their assault on the nearby world of [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]] during the [[Great Northern Crusade]] in [[11,884 BBY]].
